name: runbuild-webui
description: Local desktop client and project-bound workbench for RunBuild
author: qixiaotong

scripts.build:desktop: vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && electron .
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dir && node build/after-sign.cjs release/mac-arm64/RunBuild.app
scripts.test:navigation: node --experimental-strip-types --test startup-preferences.test.ts project-navigation.test.ts session-catalog.test.ts session-switching.test.ts session-reliability.test.ts
scripts.test:conversation: node --experimental-strip-types --test conversation-turn.test.ts session-image.test.ts permission-preference.test.ts completion-evidence.test.ts inspector-artifact-preview.test.ts
